transition: neutral ground-state ionization threshold, Li I -> Li II

reference.authors: B. A. Bushaw, W. Nörtershäuser, G. W. F. Drake, H.-J. Kluge
reference.title: Ionization energy of 6,7Li determined by triple-resonance laser spectroscopy
reference.evidence_read: Publisher abstract and author-institution abstract; full article not accessed.
reference.short_quote: extrapolation to the series limit yields IS(EI)7,6=18067.54(21)MHz.

absolute_thresholds.uncertainty_convention: As reported by the primary abstract; confidence convention not independently established here.

isotope_threshold_shift.sign_convention_reason: The inspected abstracts label the shift 7,6 but do not explicitly define whether this means EI(7)-EI(6) or the reverse. No signed difference is assigned.

missing_absolute_threshold.reason: No absolute 6Li threshold reported in the inspected abstracts; not derived while the sign convention remains unresolved.

conversion_recipe_only.joule_to_electronvolt: E_eV = E_J / eV_J; abs(DeltaE_eV) = abs(DeltaE_J) / eV_J

claim_limits: This is measured isotope-specific neutral threshold evidence, not isotope-specific thermal CI, RR or DR coefficients.
No Voronov fitted ionization-energy parameter is replaced or corrected by this donor.
No isotope shift is assigned to Li II or Li III ionization thresholds.
No thermal-rate approximation error bound follows from this donor alone.
Use in a future photoionization or energy model requires an explicit sign convention and separately frozen coupling contract.
